Existing foundation: Orbit · All chats · Feed · direct & group conversationsProposed additions: Moments entry · post reference in a chat reply
Interactive design proposal · Fictional messages · Nothing is sent · Resets on reload

One app. The same relationships.

The current shell has Orbit and Feed. Orbit defaults to the inner circle; its view toggle opens the all-chats list. A contact opens the existing direct conversation, and a group opens its group conversation.

Feed is the pending-reply inbox. In this proposal, incoming chat replies related to a moment appear there as conversation messages. Posting a moment does not create an inbox item for every friend.

The new part: a Moments entry within Orbit, a contact’s moments entry from their chat, and a post reference attached to a normal chat reply. The rich post-reference message and composer treatment are proposals, not existing implemented features.

The current conversation already accepts an initial text draft and supports quoting existing messages. A production integration would extend that context to identify an authorized post while keeping the existing contact’s conversation and its history.
